name: senpai-ask
description: A lightweight skill collection that turns Codex into a patient senior-colleague guide for total beginners — asks before it builds, brainstorms before building, works in an isolated workspace, breaks work into small reviewed steps, and remembers your project across sessions in plain language.

interface.shortDescription: A patient senior colleague for coding beginners
interface.longDescription: senpai-ask helps people who are new to coding. Before writing code it asks one question at a time to agree on what to build, does the work in a safe copy of your project, breaks it into small steps you approve, and shows it working before you decide to keep it or throw it away. It also remembers where you left off, in plain language.
